name: Sorbitol
siboNotes: Sorbitol is poorly absorbed and rapidly fermented by gut bacteria, making it unsuitable for SIBO management even in small amounts.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels carefully as sorbitol is used in many sugar-free products
Found commonly in diet sodas, sugar-free gum, and diabetic foods
Can cause digestive symptoms even in non-IBS individuals at higher doses
pairsWellWith: N/A - not recommended for low-FODMAP diet
nutritionalHighlights: provides sweetness with fewer calories than sugar
does not raise blood glucose significantly
acts as a humectant in food products
